sourceContract: Gemini CLI command hook protocol (AfterModel), final streaming chunk carrying finishReason and the closing usageMetadata snapshot
author: otel-hook integration owner (agent)
sanitization: Prompt and response text are invented single sentences; token counts are invented figures; the session id and repository root are synthetic placeholders.
notes: Shape re-derived from HookTranslatorGenAIv1.toHookLLMResponse: candidates[].content.parts is string[], and usageMetadata carries only promptTokenCount, candidatesTokenCount, and totalTokenCount — the translator drops cachedContentTokenCount and thoughtsTokenCount before any hook runs.
